## Publication Information

**Date:** 1811-14

**Imprint:** Berlin: Hitzig

**Notes:** The four seasons were each represented by one or two stories. <i>Fru?hlings-Heft. Undine</i>;<i>  Sommer-Heft. Die beiden Hauptleute</i>;<i> Herbst-Heft. Aslauga's Ritter</i>  and<i> Alpin und Jucunde</i>;<i> Winter-Heft. Sintram und seine Gefa?hrten.</i>
